images.view: High aerial view from a distance, with the whole shipyard visible inside the frame.
images.subject: A spaceship construction dock, one vast open-air dry dock cut deep into the rock and open to the sky, with gantry cranes along its rim.
images.detail: A sleek newly finished spaceship rises vertically out of the dock on bright engine glow.
images.site: The dock is cut into a plateau of dark neutral grey rock on a lifeless alien planet of bare rock.

images.subject: A high-tech nanite factory built around one colossal glass containment cylinder that rises almost to the top of the cliff.
images.detail: A swirling cloud of silver nanoparticles glows inside the cylinder.
